constraints.text: Must be browser-accessible with no native app installation required.
Must allow users to start or continue the learning journey from the landing experience.
Must include 5–10 pre-seeded AI learning missions.
Each mission must include title, difficulty, objective, lesson content and completion status.
Must include mission-linked quizzes, flashcards or checkpoints.
Must provide explanations, review guidance or learning feedback.
Must answer mission-related questions in beginner-friendly language.
Must adapt to learner level, preference or mission context.

requirements.title: AI Only Mode and AI feedback flow

constraints.text: Must support explanations, hints, feedback and next-step recommendations.
Feedback must connect to learning content and not be only a generic chatbot.
Must track missions and quiz/checkpoint results.
Must include progress, badges, milestones or completion state.

requirements.title: Content management for missions and questions

constraints.text: Admins can add or edit missions, questions and flashcards.
Admins can enable, disable, preview, publish and unpublish content.

requirements.title: Seed content and local review reliability

constraints.text: Must include committed missions, practice content, flashcards and progress data.
Must run locally with sufficient committed seed content.
Must provide mock/sample AI or clear setup guidance when no key exists.
README covers setup, AI configuration, fallback, learner and admin flows.
